args.title: Fix handling of quoted headers in CSV parser
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Modify header parsing logic in parseStatement to use splitFields function for consistent handling of quoted fields, like the first line "date","amount","description". This fixes errors where quoted headers caused mismatch of column count with rows.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The bug is caused by the header line being split on commas without using the CSV-aware splitFields function, so quoted headers lead to a column count mismatch. The parsing and validation of CSV header and rows should consistently use splitFields to handle quotes correctly. This is fixed by changing header parsing in src/ingest/parser.ts.
